name: The Hall of a Thousand Mirrors
intro: You step out of the shadows of the Sanctum of Light and into a hall of mirrors. A thousand of you step in alongside you. Somewhere in here, one of them is not you.

rooms.name: The Hall of a Thousand Mirrors - The Gallery of Glass
rooms.description: Mirrors on every wall, the floor and the ceiling, and in every one of them you, from every side at once. North, a mirror stands where a door should be.

rooms.name: The Hall of a Thousand Mirrors - The Mirror Maze
rooms.description: A maze of standing mirrors that turn as you pass, so that every way looks like every other. North, a darker mirror waits.

rooms.name: The Hall of a Thousand Mirrors - The Faceless Throne
rooms.description: A throne in a ring of broken mirrors. The one sitting on it is wearing your face, and wearing it better than you do.

waves.text: Glass sentinels step out of the mirrors!
The maze turns, and sentinels are waiting behind it!
Your reflections step out of the mirrors all around you!

gates.text: The mirror door ripples like water — you can pass.
The dark mirror clears, and something on the other side smiles with your mouth.

boss.text: The Faceless One rises, wearing your face. 'The guild sent me too, once,' it says, in your voice. 'Look what I became.'
